meta.title: Budget category Balance Amount is auto-calculated as Allocated minus Spent

args.goal: Open the Budget Creation page, go to the Budget Category List tab, click + New, enter a unique Category Name, set Budget Allocated to 100000 and Budget Spent to 25000 without entering Balance Amount, and stop with the created category form showing Balance Amount as 75000.

steps.note: Performs the budget-category creation flow and leaves the auto-calculated balance visible.
Confirms the Balance Amount displays the expected Allocated minus Spent result.
